verdict.rationale: Docs clearly show MCP integration is a first-class capability: connecting servers lets the agent query databases, integrate with APIs like Slack/GitHub, and access external tools, with support for local process, HTTP, or in-process servers, plus admin controls to manage which servers are allowed. This is well documented with dedicated MCP docs and a quickstart guide. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of MCP tool usage in practice beyond vendor docs.
